**S03 (24.9 s)**
Emotion 2 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 2 · Composition 3

1. **0.0–2.5 s:** The corner tags ("ILLUSTRATIVE", "US only · history, not a forecast") are already on screen at 2.49 s. The brief says they come in after the rates. Hold them back until the "US only" line (about 13.9 s) so they land as their own beat.
2. **12.4 s:** The right card says "30-year paid in 15" but shows 7.40%, which is the plain 30-year survey rate. That label is wrong for this number. Retitle the card "30-year mortgage", and show the paid-in-15 idea in a later scene. The "7.40%" text also sits on the teal bar, so it's partly covered. Raise the number or drop the bar lower.
3. **17.4–24.9 s:** The rate cards are gone by 17.4 s. The last 7.5 s show a small Tessa from behind beside a house in a large empty frame, and nothing moves after "invest" at 20.2 s, so about 4.7 s of the scene is dead. Keep the cards up through 20.2 s, then start pushing the camera toward the house or begin bringing in the S04 bars.
4. **Throughout:** "ILLUSTRATIVE" appears twice, once in the corner and again in Tessa's name tag. Tessa is also tiny and turned away, so the scene has no emotional hook. Change her tag to just "Tessa", and turn her toward the cards so she seems to be looking at the rates.

**S04 (17.8 s)**
Emotion 2 · Sound-off 4 · Pacing 3 · Composition 3

1. **1.8 s:** A blank bar with no label sits alone on the right while Tessa and the house drift to the far left edge. The brief asks for bars over Tessa, not away from her. Keep her centered and grow the bars up behind or above her.
2. **8.9 s:** The second bar is already up 2.3 s before "thirty-year" (11.2 s), so the comparison happens before the narration gets there. Grow it starting at 11.2 s, timed to "only requires".
3. **12.5–16.0 s:** The two bars are the same grey and are labeled differently: the 15-year label sits left of its bar and the 30-year label sits right of its bar. The payoff ("only requires" less) has no visual weight. Give each bar its own color, put the labels in the same place on both (above or at the base), and show a bracket for the gap of about $612.
4. **Throughout:** Tessa doesn't react to either bar. The money stack from S03 also disappears, which breaks continuity. Have her turn toward the shorter bar when "only" is said (about 12.1 s), and keep the money stack in the shot.

The bar heights are in the correct ratio (about 0.78).
